notes: «جميعا عن الوليد» makes Zuhayr and Ubaydullah co-transmitters in the first level.
The editor glosses «- قال زهير حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم -» and «- هو ابن عبد الرحمن -» are left out; the first gives Walid's fuller name in Zuhayr's own route, and no identity is decided here.
«قال الوليد فقلت للأوزاعي ...» is a later question about the meaning, not a further isnad; it is not a link and is not written.
